title: Apartment Collection by Hilton Announces First International Signings Amid Growing Owner Demand
summary: Apartment Collection by Hilton has signed international properties in the United Arab Emirates and Turks and Caicos.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


The brand has built momentum with key U.S. openings and has more than 60 deals in various stages of negotiation across U.S. and international markets


- **Apartment Collection by Hilton has signed the first international properties in the United Arab Emirates and Turks and Caicos, marking the brand's expansion outside the United States and extending its footprint into the Middle East and Caribbean regions.**
- **The brand has signed its first development agreements beyond launch partner Placemakr, reflecting growing interest in apartment-style accommodations.**


**MCLEAN, Va. —**[Apartment Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/apartment-collection/?msockid=360ff0e0dd016d912f77e61fdc8b6cb2) , Hilton's (Nasdaq: HLT) extended-stay, apartment-style lodging brand, today announced its first signings outside the United States, in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, expected to open in December 2026 and Grace Bay, Turks and Caicos, expected to open in 2028. The signings mark a significant milestone as the brand surpasses 60 deals in various stages of negotiation globally and secures its first development agreements beyond seed partner Placemakr, signaling growing owner and developer confidence in the brand and the expanding hospitality-driven apartment segment.


-
-


Through Hilton's partnership with Placemakr, Apartment Collection by Hilton has quickly established an operating footprint with recent U.S. openings in Tempe, Arizona, Huntsville, Alabama, Atlanta, Salt Lake City, Pittsburgh and Austin. The growing portfolio provides early proof of concept for the brand while demonstrating demand for apartment-style accommodations within the Hilton ecosystem.


Apartment Collection by Hilton offers fully furnished apartments with amenities such as chef-ready kitchens, separate living areas, fitness centers and in-unit laundry. Guests are thoughtfully hosted, with dedicated team members available on-site 24/7 to provide support and ensure they feel cared for, in addition to conveniences such as housekeeping every seven days for those settling in for an extended period of time.


-
-


The brand is designed to meet modern travelers' needs for flexibility, functionality and space across short- and long-term stays – and that flexibility also creates a compelling development opportunity. As extended stays, group travel and blended business-leisure trips become more common, owners are exploring apartment-style accommodations as a complementary use for multifamily, mixed-use and adaptive reuse developments – supported by the consistency, service and commercial engine of Hilton.


“Apartment Collection by Hilton represents an important step in expanding Hilton’s extended stay offerings and bringing our trusted hospitality to a new lodging category,” said Michael Snapkoski, global brand leader, Apartment Collection by Hilton. “For owners and developers, the brand offers a compelling model that pairs residential-style assets with Hilton’s distribution, brand recognition and commercial support, creating more ways for guests to choose Hilton for every stay.”


## Recent and Upcoming Openings:


Located in the heart of sought-after destinations, each Apartment Collection by Hilton stay delivers an elevated experience that captures the local character of its surroundings with the convenience and comforts of apartment living. Recent and upcoming openings include:


- [Apartment Collection by Hilton, Dubai Downtown](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/dxbauaq-dubai-downtown/)( Dubai, United Arab Emirates; expected to open December 2026) will make its Middle East debut with a waterfront stay on Marasi Drive in Business Bay, close to the restaurants and promenades of the Dubai Water Canal. Guests can unwind by the swimming pool, maintain their routines at the fitness center, or make use of the children’s playground, while world-class shopping and entertainment at The Dubai Mall, the Burj Khalifa and the many attractions of Downtown Dubai are all within easy reach. The property will feature 388 apartments, including studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom accommodations designed for both short and extended stays.
- [Placemakr Tempe, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/phxaqaq-tempe/) (Tempe, Arizona; expected to open December 2026) will offer a lakeside stay along Tempe Town Lake in the new South Pier district, with easy access to downtown dining, shopping, entertainment and outdoor recreation. The spacious residential-style accommodations will include studio to three-bedroom layouts to combine the comforts of home with the pleasures of a hotel stay. The outdoor patio offers a great location to relax with lakeside views, and the clubhouse provides plenty of entertainment.
- [Placemakr Pittsburgh Downtown, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pitpmaq-pittsburgh-downtown/) (Pittsburgh; opened September 2026) sits in the heart of Downtown Pittsburgh, just steps from the city's Cultural District and within easy reach of acclaimed theaters, dining, entertainment venues, and major business hubs. Housed in The Pennsylvanian, an iconic Pittsburgh landmark, the property welcomes guests with a Gilded Age-era lobby and offers access to a golden ballroom available to host any occasion, from grand celebrations to everyday gatherings.
- [Anthem House - Placemakr Huntsville, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hsvpmaq-anthem-house-huntsville/) (Huntsville, Alabama; opened September 2026) features private balconies, a fitness center, outdoor pool and meeting and event spaces in Huntsville’s energetic MidCity District. The property is just moments from one of the city’s fastest-growing neighborhoods, where innovation, culture and community come together.
- [Scout Living PCM | Placemakr Atlanta, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/atlaqaq-scout-living-atlanta/) **** (Atlanta; opened Spring 2026) is set within Ponce City Market in the historic Old Fourth Ward, steps from James Beard Award-winning chefs, local shops and cultural attractions. After exploring the best of the city, guests can relax at the heated rooftop pool, catch up on work in one of the co-working spaces or skip the reservations and enjoy a meal in their apartment.
- [Placemakr Salt Lake City Downtown, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/slcpmaq-salt-lake-city/) **** (Salt Lake City; opened Spring 2026) provides a centrally located downtown home base surrounded by a mix of dining options and green spaces with easy access to the Wasatch Mountains. The 24/7 fitness center supports daily routines, while an on-site conference room makes it easy to mix business with leisure.
- [Placemakr Austin Downtown, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ausaqaq-austin-downtown/?cid=OH,AQ,PropAUSAQAQ,MULTIPR,dynamicGrid1,Home,Brand) (Austin; opened July 2026) brings guests to the vibrant Rainey Street district, known for its creative spirit and distinctive flavors. Nearby dining options include local favorites from TexMex to cozy cafes, intimate wine bars and lively grills. When dining in is preferred, the property is equipped with a covered patio area with a kitchen and dining table to host dinner alfresco and an expansive outdoor pool.


To learn more about Apartment Collection by Hilton, visit[stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/) .

##### FAQ: Apartment Collection by Hilton Announces First International Signings Amid Growing Owner Demand


Apartment Collection by Hilton is expanding its development pipeline with its first signed properties outside the continental United States, its first development deals with new partners and more than 60 deals in various stages of negotiation across the U.S. and international markets.


Apartment Collection by Hilton signed its first international properties in the United Arab Emirates and Turks and Caicos. Its property in Dubai is expected to open in December 2026.


In partnership with Placemakr, Apartment Collection by Hilton has opened six U.S. properties so far in 2026, with more expected to open in 2027.


Apartment Collection by Hilton offers furnished studios up to four-bedroom residences with chef-ready kitchens, spacious living areas and on-site amenities such as laundry and fitness centers, paired with Hilton service standards and Hilton Honors benefits.


Apartment Collection by Hilton is an apartment-style lodging brand within Hilton’s collection portfolio, offering furnished studios up to four-bedroom residences designed for both short- and long-term stays.
